Topic.label: Three Views and Visualizing Solids from Three Views

Question: Which of the following solids has a front view, left view, and top view that are all squares?
Solution: A cube appears as a square when viewed directly toward any face. The three views of a sphere are all circles, while the three views of a cylinder or cone include circles or triangles.
